"""Read-only sanitized serving acceptance and pre-registration ledger."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request

assert os.geteuid() == 0 and os.uname().nodename == 'anvil-qa-v1'
root = Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1')
backup = root / 'backups/qualification-e49e149-v2'
summary = json.loads((backup / 'rollout-summary.json').read_bytes())
assert summary['revision'] == 'e49e149d814d43b8028d11cfe95e7398acbf8318'
assert summary['source_sha256'] == 'c26a7965e3ee215aa74e495c5341c15a2e0423f3952a1799111e8eef688201e4'
assert summary['component_receipt_sha256'] == '05ee9325ada9634653a22f47a9d84195127f943f661e9a8ca8a4f0805034a482'
assert summary['capture_receipt_sha256'] == 'ec98eb6bcacdbb16217227d43a37fa7359169c8190e4dc4cf4aa5120a505acff'
out = {'observed_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'rollout': summary, 'services': {}, 'profiles': {}}
def run(args, data=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, input=data, timeout=60)
for role, expected in summary['services'].items():
    info = json.loads(run(['docker','inspect', 'anvil-qa-v1-' + role + '-1']))[0]
    assert info['Id'] == expected['id'] and info['Config']['Image'] == expected['image']
    assert info['State']['Running'] and info['RestartCount'] == 0
    flags = {k: v for k, v in (item.split('=',1) for item in info['Config']['Env']) if k in ('ANVIL_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED','ANVIL_HARBOR_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED','ANVIL_PRAXIS_TEMPLATE_CALLS_ENABLED','ANVIL_REAL_EMAIL_ENABLED')}
    assert all(value.lower() in ('false','0','off') for value in flags.values())
    out['services'][role] = {'id': info['Id'], 'image': info['Config']['Image'], 'image_id': info['Image'], 'revision': info['Config']['Labels'].get('org.opencontainers.image.revision'), 'running': True, 'restart_count': 0, 'disabled_flags': flags}
    out['profiles'][role] = {'HostConfig': info['HostConfig'], 'Mounts': info['Mounts'], 'user': info['Config']['User'], 'cmd': info['Config']['Cmd'], 'entrypoint': info['Config']['Entrypoint']}
out['config_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256((root / 'config/compose-app.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
out['receipts'] = {}
for name, path in [('component',root/'runtime-functional/harbor-proof/component-qualification/current.json'),('capture',root/'runtime-functional/capture-database-qualification/current.json')]:
    raw = path.read_bytes(); body = json.loads(raw)
    assert datetime.fromisoformat(body['expires_at'].replace('Z','+00:00')) > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    out['receipts'][name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'expires_at':body['expires_at']}
sql = """BEGIN READ ONLY;
SELECT json_build_object(
'imports', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id',id,'pack_id',pack_id,'source_sha256',manifest->>'source_sha256','task_mode',manifest->>'task_mode','manifest_sha256',manifest_sha256)), '[]'::json) FROM banking.anvil_imports WHERE project_id='a7454c18-602e-4907-bdd9-277067c36233'),
'registration_idempotency', (SELECT count(*) FROM anvil.idempotency WHERE project_id='a7454c18-602e-4907-bdd9-277067c36233' AND route LIKE '%golden-banking%'),
'pending_app_transactions', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND usename='anvil_app' AND xact_start IS NOT NULL AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()),
'commands', (SELECT count(*) FROM banking.commands),
'execution_jobs', (SELECT count(*) FROM banking.execution_jobs),
'application_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM banking.applications WHERE project_id='a7454c18-602e-4907-bdd9-277067c36233' AND pack_id='7e17aa6b-4a23-4abc-a28f-f4ba97186c2d'),
'schema', (SELECT max(version) FROM anvil.schema_versions),
'alembic', (SELECT version_num FROM anvil.alembic_version));
ROLLBACK;"""
command = 'exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -X -A -t -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1'
out['ledger'] = json.loads(run(['docker','exec','-i','anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1','sh','-c',command],sql.encode()))
for key, path in [('health','https://anvil-qa.adi-labs.ai/api/v1/health'),('workspace','https://anvil-qa.adi-labs.ai/workspace')]:
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(path,timeout=20) as response:
            out[key] = {'status':response.status}
            if key == 'health': out[key]['body'] = json.load(response)
    except Exception as error:
        out[key] = {'error_type':type(error).__name__}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
